svg.title: Logistic regression with raw and with quadratic features
svg.desc: Two scatter plots of the same points, one class clustered inside a tilted ellipse and the other around it. Left: logistic regression on the two raw features draws a straight line that cannot separate them. Right: the same algorithm given the squares and the product of the features draws an ellipse around the inner class.
svg.text: features x₁, x₂: a straight line
adding x₁², x₂², x₁x₂: an ellipse
